app.notes: Your nodes, watched: every 15 minutes GNOT looks at each node of yours the way its page in Monitor/Vote does, and a bell at the top right lists anything worth a look; the serious things also come as a desktop notice. When you close GNOT with a node of your own, it can keep watching from an icon near the clock. Step 1 shows the number of hosts again under each model's share, counting only hosts the network measured doing that work, and lists the models hosts run that have no ready-made setup in GNOT yet. The wallet step says so when a wallet already has a node on another server: one wallet is one node.
